title: Sapphire Mod
description: A lightweight Forge mod that introduces sapphire ore and a full tool set, offering stronger and more durable gear for players seeking a simple survival upgrade.
body:
With the Sapphire Mod, upgrade your Minecraft experience with brand-new tools! This mod adds fresh items crafted from the precious Sapphire gem—beautiful and practical.
🔧 Features:
- Sapphire Tools: Includes sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe with high durability and strength.
- Crafting Recipes: All tools come with custom recipes and are easy to craft.
- Forge Compatible: Works with Minecraft: Java Edition.
Perfect for players who want new gear without extra complexity. Easy to install, fun to use—have a good mood with Sapphire!
